/presentation.en: A 35-year-old man is brought by a friend because he is difficult to wake and is breathing slowly.
/presentation.es: Un hombre de 35 años es traído por un amigo porque cuesta despertarlo y respira lentamente.

/history/chief_complaint/0.en: His friend says he became difficult to wake and started breathing very slowly.
/history/chief_complaint/0.es: Su amigo cuenta que se volvió difícil despertarlo y que empezó a respirar muy lentamente.

/history/associated_symptoms/0.en: His friend noticed increasing sleepiness after he took a tablet for back pain.
/history/associated_symptoms/0.es: Su amigo notó somnolencia progresiva después de que tomó una pastilla para el dolor de espalda.

/history/associated_symptoms/1.en: There was no witnessed seizure, fall or trauma.
/history/associated_symptoms/1.es: No se presenció ninguna convulsión, caída ni traumatismo.

/history/medical_history/0.en: His friend reports a recent back strain and no known chronic neurological disorder.
/history/medical_history/0.es: Su amigo refiere una distensión de espalda reciente y ningún trastorno neurológico crónico conocido.

/history/medications/0.en: He took a tablet obtained from an acquaintance for pain; its contents are not confirmed.
/history/medications/0.es: Tomó una pastilla para el dolor obtenida de un conocido; su contenido no está confirmado.

/history/allergies/0.en: No known medication allergies are reported.
/history/allergies/0.es: No se refieren alergias medicamentosas conocidas.

/history/onset/0.en: Increasing sleepiness began within the last hour after the tablet.
/history/onset/0.es: La somnolencia progresiva comenzó en la última hora, después de tomar la pastilla.

/history/risk_factors/0.en: There is a recent exposure to a medication of uncertain contents.
/history/risk_factors/0.es: Hay una exposición reciente a un medicamento de contenido incierto.

/history/exposure/0.en: His friend reports one pain tablet from an acquaintance; the drug identity and amount are not established.
/history/exposure/0.es: Su amigo refiere una pastilla para el dolor obtenida de un conocido; no se han establecido la identidad del fármaco ni la cantidad.

/history/breathing/0.en: His friend counted long pauses between small, shallow breaths.
/history/breathing/0.es: Su amigo contó pausas largas entre respiraciones pequeñas y superficiales.

/history/neurological_symptoms/0.en: He became progressively sleepy without a witnessed focal deficit.
/history/neurological_symptoms/0.es: Se puso progresivamente somnoliento, sin que se presenciara un déficit focal.

/examination/Respiratory.en: Very slow, shallow breaths with reduced chest excursion; breath sounds are equal when air enters.
/examination/Respiratory.es: Respiraciones muy lentas y superficiales, con expansión torácica disminuida; el murmullo pulmonar es simétrico cuando entra aire.

/examination/Abdomen.es: Blando, sin dolor focal a la palpación.

/examination/Neurological.en: Obtunded, with small reactive pupils and brief bilateral withdrawal to firm stimulation; no visible head injury.
/examination/Neurological.es: Obnubilado, con pupilas pequeñas y reactivas, y retiro bilateral breve ante un estímulo firme; sin traumatismo craneano visible.

/investigations/pocus/result/rv.en: Smaller than the LV; no septal flattening (no D-sign); no McConnell sign
/investigations/pocus/result/rv.es: Menor que el VI; sin aplanamiento septal (sin signo D); sin signo de McConnell

/investigations/pocus/result/ivc.en: 1.8 cm; minimal respiratory variation with shallow breaths
/investigations/pocus/result/ivc.es: 1.8 cm; variación respiratoria mínima con respiraciones superficiales

/investigations/pocus/result/lungs.es: Sin líneas B; patrón de líneas A bilateral

/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_desce.en: Not dilated in the visible segment
/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_desce.es: No dilatada en el segmento visible

/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_abdom.en: Normal calibre from the diaphragm to the iliac bifurcation
/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_abdom.es: Calibre normal desde el diafragma hasta la bifurcación ilíaca

/investigations/chest_xray/result/report.en: No focal infiltrate or pulmonary edema.
/investigations/chest_xray/result/report.es: Sin infiltrado focal ni edema pulmonar.

/investigations/troponin/result/report.en: Single sample; interpret with symptoms and ECG. Serial testing requires a new sample.
/investigations/troponin/result/report.es: Muestra única; interpretar junto con los síntomas y el ECG. La medición seriada requiere una nueva muestra.

/investigations/urinalysis/result/report.en: No leukocyte esterase, nitrite or blood detected.
/investigations/urinalysis/result/report.es: No se detectan esterasa leucocitaria, nitritos ni sangre.

/investigations/blood_cultures/result/re.en: Samples collected; culture identification and susceptibility results are pending.
/investigations/blood_cultures/result/re.es: Muestras tomadas; los resultados de identificación y susceptibilidad del cultivo están pendientes.

/presentation.en: A 67-year-old woman is brought from home with increasing sleepiness and slow breathing noticed by her spouse.
/presentation.es: Una mujer de 67 años es traída desde su casa con somnolencia progresiva y respiración lenta advertidas por su cónyuge.

/history/chief_complaint/0.en: Her spouse reports that she has become increasingly sleepy and is breathing slowly.
/history/chief_complaint/0.es: Su cónyuge refiere que ella se ha puesto cada vez más somnolienta y que respira lentamente.

/history/associated_symptoms/0.en: Her spouse has struggled to keep her awake this morning.
/history/associated_symptoms/0.es: A su cónyuge le ha costado mantenerla despierta esta mañana.

/history/associated_symptoms/1.en: There was no witnessed seizure, head injury or febrile illness.
/history/associated_symptoms/1.es: No se presenció ninguna convulsión, traumatismo craneano ni cuadro febril.

/history/medical_history/0.en: Her spouse reports chronic pain and chronic kidney disease; she normally converses clearly and manages at home.
/history/medical_history/0.es: Su cónyuge refiere dolor crónico y enfermedad renal crónica; habitualmente conversa con claridad y se las arregla en casa.

/history/medications/0.en: Her medication list includes sustained-release morphine; her spouse is uncertain whether today's dose was repeated.
/history/medications/0.es: Su lista de medicamentos incluye morfina de liberación prolongada; su cónyuge no sabe con certeza si la dosis de hoy se repitió.

/history/allergies/0.en: No known medication allergies are reported.
/history/allergies/0.es: No se refieren alergias medicamentosas conocidas.

/history/onset/0.en: She became progressively sleepier during the morning after taking her regular medication.
/history/onset/0.es: Se puso progresivamente más somnolienta durante la mañana, después de tomar sus medicamentos habituales.

/history/risk_factors/0.en: She receives a long-acting opioid and has impaired renal function.
/history/risk_factors/0.es: Recibe un opioide de acción prolongada y tiene la función renal deteriorada.

/history/exposure/0.en: Sustained-release morphine is prescribed; a possible repeated dose is unconfirmed, and no intent is established.
/history/exposure/0.es: Tiene indicada morfina de liberación prolongada; no se ha confirmado una posible dosis repetida, y no se ha establecido intencionalidad.

/history/breathing/0.en: Her spouse noticed unusually slow shallow breathing with occasional pauses.
/history/breathing/0.es: Su cónyuge notó una respiración inusualmente lenta y superficial, con pausas ocasionales.

/history/oral_intake/0.en: She has eaten little today because she has been too sleepy.
/history/oral_intake/0.es: Hoy ha comido poco porque ha estado demasiado somnolienta.

/examination/Respiratory.en: Slow shallow breathing with reduced chest excursion; no focal wheeze or crackles.
/examination/Respiratory.es: Respiración lenta y superficial, con expansión torácica disminuida; sin sibilancias ni crépitos focales.

/examination/Neurological.en: Obtunded with small reactive pupils, briefly withdrawing both arms to a firm stimulus.
/examination/Neurological.es: Obnubilada, con pupilas pequeñas y reactivas, retira brevemente ambos brazos ante un estímulo firme.

/investigations/pocus/result/rv.en: Smaller than the LV; no septal flattening (no D-sign); no McConnell sign
/investigations/pocus/result/rv.es: Menor que el VI; sin aplanamiento septal (sin signo D); sin signo de McConnell

/investigations/pocus/result/ivc.en: 1.9 cm; minimal respiratory variation with shallow breaths
/investigations/pocus/result/ivc.es: 1.9 cm; variación respiratoria mínima con respiraciones superficiales

/investigations/pocus/result/lungs.es: Sin líneas B; patrón de líneas A bilateral

/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_desce.en: Not dilated in the visible segment
/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_desce.es: No dilatada en el segmento visible

/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_abdom.en: Normal calibre from the diaphragm to the iliac bifurcation
/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_abdom.es: Calibre normal desde el diafragma hasta la bifurcación ilíaca

/investigations/troponin/result/report.en: Single sample; interpret with symptoms and ECG. Serial testing requires a new sample.
/investigations/troponin/result/report.es: Muestra única; interpretar junto con los síntomas y el ECG. La medición seriada requiere una nueva muestra.

/investigations/urinalysis/result/report.en: No leukocyte esterase, nitrite or blood detected.
/investigations/urinalysis/result/report.es: No se detectan esterasa leucocitaria, nitritos ni sangre.

/investigations/blood_cultures/result/re.en: Samples collected; culture identification and susceptibility results are pending.
/investigations/blood_cultures/result/re.es: Muestras tomadas; los resultados de identificación y susceptibilidad del cultivo están pendientes.
